policy: The full pipeline remains runnable. Missing calibrated inputs use centralized versioned defaults or V3.2 missing-value renormalization, and every substitution is labeled in stage compliance artifacts.

m1_comparable.current_blocker: No 48-dimensional emotion vector or approved emotion-tag model is delivered.
m1_comparable.current_treatment: The component remains missing and its weight is renormalized; Path2 cannot be formally activated.

m1_comparable.current_blocker: No point-in-time external IP/platform snapshot is delivered.
m1_comparable.current_treatment: Cext=1, which is the V3.2 neutral missing-input treatment.

m1_comparable.current_blocker: Full Train leave-one-SKU-out tuning has not been implemented or run.
m1_comparable.current_treatment: Reference config values support smoke tests; stage report is partial_v3_2_output.

m2_restore.current_blocker: Planned distribution quantity/date and planned/actual display dates are absent.
m2_restore.current_treatment: first_store_arrival_time and first in-stock/display evidence are used only as labeled proxies; fulfillment/delay metrics are not fabricated.

m2_restore.current_blocker: No daily valid-business/closure calendar is delivered.
m2_restore.current_treatment: Store status/open-close dates plus operational rows form a nullable Eopen proxy; unknown remains null.

m2_restore.current_blocker: The current restoration model does not yet include all V3.2 tier/city/mall/area covariates and requires full Train validation.
m2_restore.current_treatment: Huber item/store/category-or-global effects and price term are used and reported as a partial model, not a final trained model.

m2_restore.current_blocker: No confirmed event calendar is supplied.
m2_restore.current_treatment: H=1 with neutral_no_event status, explicitly permitted by V3.2 when no schedule applies.

round6.formal_implementation: Optional overrides are accepted through --placement-policy-file and validated per store_tier.
round6.current_blocker: The PDF specifies the role of these parameters but not their business-calibrated values.
round6.current_treatment: v_min,g uses the historical store-tier median; inv_max=0.40 and tau_tier=0.50 are centralized versioned initial values pending Train calibration.

round6.formal_implementation: The adapter builds launch-window arrival evidence from first_store_arrival_time; a trained probability snapshot may override it through --placement-evidence-file.
round6.current_blocker: The current M2 artifact contains observed restore rows, not a definitive planned/not-planned store universe.
round6.current_treatment: Use the versioned 28-day window and current eligible-store universe, compute group empirical p_prior/p_perf and V3.2 shrinkage, and label the planned-vs-missing ambiguity. If raw launch evidence cannot be read, use the labeled M2 exposure proxy.

round6.formal_implementation: Read a standardized target-store feature snapshot; missing values follow V3.2 weight renormalization.
round6.current_blocker: Round 4 was limited to selected SKU post-launch windows and cannot prove complete last-90-day same-category coverage.
round6.current_treatment: Missing remains null and score weights are renormalized; no fabricated 0.5 value.

round6.formal_implementation: Read the in-stock-day ratio with in_stock_not_displayed_flag=0 from a standardized feature snapshot.
round6.current_blocker: A versioned representative SKU/time universe has not been supplied.
round6.current_treatment: Missing remains null and score weights are renormalized; operate_size is never used as a proxy.

round6.formal_implementation: Open/closed status is enforced from the store snapshot.
round6.current_blocker: Distribution reachability, store bans and category/theme qualification are not present in delivered fields.
round6.current_treatment: Unavailable constraints do not block the runnable pipeline, but are reported as unchecked and never presented as verified.

round6.formal_implementation: Emits every week 1..Wlife from one validated week-1-normalized profile: selected comparables first, then L4/L3/L2/L1/global lifecycle priors.
round6.current_blocker: A trained product-random/store-tier-fixed-effects model is not yet available for residual gaps.
round6.current_treatment: A profile must have a positive non-negligible week-1 anchor, enough observed weeks/samples, finite non-negative factors and no factor above the versioned guardrail. Missing weeks are interpolated or edge-carried only within that one source; sources are never spliced week by week. If every historical profile is invalid, the full tier curve uses the labeled versioned flat default.

m5_factors.current_blocker: Several V3.2 social, IP, product, operation and competition raw fields are not delivered.
m5_factors.current_treatment: Missing groups are neutralized; available member/supplier fields are exploratory standardized features and are not claimed as final V3.2 factors.

m5_factors.current_blocker: V3.2 requires Train-only constrained OOF fitting; that joint training block is not implemented.
m5_factors.current_treatment: Reference config parameters are smoke-only and run_factors reports requires_real_training.

m5_factors.current_blocker: No versioned competition input is supplied.
m5_factors.current_treatment: Ccompetition=1 unless an explicit rule snapshot is passed.

m6_m7_first_order.current_blocker: Formal planning cadence, lead schedule, sell-end and license-end inputs are not delivered.
m6_m7_first_order.current_treatment: Reference horizons support smoke tests and are labeled requires confirmation; a formal run must provide constraints.

m6_m7_first_order.current_blocker: No confirmed phased-arrival curve is supplied.
m6_m7_first_order.current_treatment: All selected stores are treated as normal launch coverage; this is not a substitute for a confirmed phased rollout.

m6_m7_first_order.current_blocker: Confirmed m_s and d_s are not delivered.
m6_m7_first_order.current_treatment: Both default to zero with missing_set_zero_per_v3_2 status; no unit is fabricated.

m6_m7_first_order.current_blocker: Formal supply constraint snapshots are absent.
m6_m7_first_order.current_treatment: Document reference MOQ/mold values are smoke-only; output explicitly requires business confirmation.

m6_m7_first_order.current_blocker: Qsample, Qstability and Qbacktest require trained OOF evidence.
m6_m7_first_order.current_treatment: Current reliability is uncalibrated and must not be interpreted as the formal V3.2 probability.

training.current_blocker: Current rolling OOF code fits a generic regularized model but does not jointly train all V3.2 similarity, factor, lifecycle, reorder residual and reliability blocks.

n1_n6_reorder.current_blocker: No trained horizon/category residual model is available.
n1_n6_reorder.current_treatment: Only the Actual/Plan main-path Mdev is active; no residual uplift is fabricated.

n1_n6_reorder.current_blocker: Warehouse inventory, inbound ETA, waiting demand, protected inventory, lead schedule, MOQ and capacity need a decision-time snapshot.
n1_n6_reorder.current_treatment: Constraints may be supplied for smoke; absent formal inputs are listed in the report and no production-ready claim is made.

n1_n6_reorder.current_blocker: Refund semantics are unverified and future-window calibration labels are not mature.
